title: Collision QA fixes - native CRS, full road coverage, spatial indexing

defect_summary.native_crs_frame: collision_check used parse_obj_origin + parse_geo_reference + project_wgs84_to_xodr to transform OBJ bounds into XODR frame, but the frame conversion was not validated against the XODR's actual CRS. If the XODR used a different CRS, the collision check would be in the wrong frame.
defect_summary.sampled_roads: collision_check had a sample_roads parameter defaulting to 2000, meaning only the first 2000 road corridors were checked. For maps with >2000 roads, some corridors were never validated.
defect_summary.local_offset_handling: OBJ local frame offset handling (origin_xodr = origin_x + obj_x, origin_yodr = origin_y - obj_z) assumed a specific coordinate convention without validation.
defect_summary.no_spatial_indexing: Collision check iterated all objects against all road corridors (O(objects * roads)). For large maps, this is O(n*m) and slow. No spatial index (R-tree, quadtree) was used.
defect_summary.missing_full_lateral_envelope: Road corridor half-width used fixed CORRIDOR_LANE_WIDTH_M (3.5m) + CORRIDOR_BUFFER_M (3.0m) = 6.5m total half-width. Did not account for actual lane widths, lane offsets, or superelevation which can extend the lateral envelope significantly.

corrected_semantics.native_crs_validation: Added explicit CRS validation: parse_obj_origin + parse_geo_reference must agree on the CRS. If XODR geoReference and OBJ origin declare different CRS, collision check fails with UNPROJECTABLE verdict.
corrected_semantics.full_road_coverage: Removed sample_roads default (was 2000). Now checks ALL road corridors by default. sample_roads parameter is now optional and deprecated for production use.
corrected_semantics.local_offset_validation: Added explicit coordinate frame documentation: OBJ bounds (x,y,z) with origin at (0,0,0). OBJ x -> XODR x (origin_x + obj_x). OBJ z -> XODR y (origin_y - obj_z) because OBJ z is up and XODR y is north. This is documented in _obj_footprint_xodr().
corrected_semantics.spatial_indexing: Added R-tree spatial index (via rtree library if available, fallback to bounding box grid) for O(log n) corridor lookup per object. Falls back to O(n) scan if rtree unavailable.
corrected_semantics.full_lateral_envelope: Replaced fixed corridor half-width with per-road curve-aware bounds from road_bounds_curve_aware() which includes actual lane widths, lane offsets, and superelevation extrema. Corridor half-width = max lane width per section * 2 + CORRIDOR_BUFFER_M.

tests.new_coverage: Added test for full road coverage (no sampling), test for CRS mismatch detection, test for spatial index correctness

residual_risks: rtree library is optional dependency. If unavailable, falls back to O(n) scan. Production should ensure rtree is installed.
OBJ unit validation (1 unit = 1 meter) is assumed but not enforced. A malformed OBJ with different units would produce false collision results.
Superelevation extrema are included in road_bounds_curve_aware but their contribution to lateral envelope is approximated. Exact 3D collision would require mesh-level analysis.
